Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer made an error by not successfully identifying or confirming the release date for both Lo Zappatore and Placer Sangriento at the very beginning. It started multiple web searches without effectively gathering or synthesizing the necessary release date information for each film. This first step set a pattern of repeated attempts to locate detailed date information for Lo Zappatore, sometimes creating confusion between Lo Zappatore (1950) and Zappatore (1980), and neglected initiating a similarly directed search for Placer Sangriento, leaving that part incomplete throughout the conversation.
